entries.example_en: There are seven days in a week.
entries.example_vi: Một tuần có bảy ngày.
entries.cloze_en: There are twenty-four hours in one day.

entries.example_en: It is time for lunch now.
entries.example_vi: Bây giờ là giờ ăn trưa rồi.
entries.cloze_en: It is twelve o'clock now, so it is time for lunch.

entries.example_en: I have one brother and two sisters.
entries.example_vi: Mình có một anh trai và hai chị gái.
entries.cloze_en: I have one brother and no sisters, so we are two children.

entries.example_en: My little sister is six years old.
entries.example_vi: Em gái mình sáu tuổi.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that three and three make six.

entries.example_en: Our class starts at ten in the morning.
entries.example_vi: Lớp tụi mình bắt đầu lúc mười giờ sáng.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that five and five make ten.

entries.definition_en: to get out of bed in the morning
entries.example_en: I get up at six every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào mình cũng dậy lúc sáu giờ.
entries.cloze_en: I get up at six every morning and brush my teeth.

entries.example_en: We have two cats at home.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình nuôi hai con mèo.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that one and one make two.

entries.example_en: School finishes at five in the afternoon.
entries.example_vi: Trường tan học lúc năm giờ chiều.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that two and three make five.

entries.example_en: There are four people in my family.
entries.example_vi: Gia đình mình có bốn người.
entries.cloze_en: Our dog runs fast on its four strong legs.

entries.example_en: I study English for one hour every day.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi ngày mình học tiếng Anh một tiếng.
entries.cloze_en: The movie is sixty minutes long, so it is one hour.

entries.example_en: The shop opens at nine.
entries.example_vi: Cửa hàng mở cửa lúc chín giờ.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that four and five make nine.

entries.definition_en: what we measure in hours and minutes
entries.example_en: What time is it? It is eight.
entries.example_vi: Mấy giờ rồi? Tám giờ.
entries.cloze_en: Look at the clock. The time is eight o'clock, so we must go.

entries.definition_en: seven days, from Monday to Sunday
entries.example_en: I visit my grandparents every week.
entries.example_vi: Tuần nào mình cũng về thăm ông bà.
entries.cloze_en: There are seven days in a week.

entries.example_en: Tet is the start of a new year.
entries.example_vi: Tết là khởi đầu của một năm mới.
entries.cloze_en: There are twelve months in a year.

entries.example_en: Our school day starts at eight.
entries.example_vi: Ngày học ở trường bắt đầu lúc tám giờ.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that four and four make eight.

entries.example_en: Today is my first day at the new school.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay là ngày đầu tiên mình học ở trường mới.
entries.cloze_en: January is the first month of the year.

entries.definition_en: on all days, with no day missing
entries.example_en: I ride my bike to school every day.
entries.example_vi: Ngày nào mình cũng đạp xe đến trường.
entries.cloze_en: I ride my bike to school every day, from Monday to Friday.

entries.definition_en: one of the twelve parts of a year
entries.example_en: My birthday is next month.
entries.example_vi: Tháng sau là sinh nhật mình.
entries.cloze_en: A month has about thirty days.

entries.example_en: My dad never drinks coffee at night.
entries.example_vi: Bố mình không bao giờ uống cà phê buổi tối.
entries.cloze_en: My dad never drinks coffee at night because he can't sleep after it.

entries.definition_en: the dark time when people sleep
entries.example_en: I can see many stars at night.
entries.example_vi: Ban đêm mình thấy rất nhiều sao.
entries.cloze_en: The sky is dark and full of stars. It is night now.

entries.example_en: We often play soccer after school.
entries.example_vi: Tan học tụi mình hay đá bóng.
entries.cloze_en: We often play soccer after school, about four times a week.

entries.example_en: My brother goes to school at seven.
entries.example_vi: Anh mình đi học lúc bảy giờ.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that three and four make seven.

entries.example_en: I eat three meals a day.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi ngày mình ăn ba bữa.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that one and two make three.

entries.example_en: Today we have a math test.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay tụi mình có bài kiểm tra toán.
entries.cloze_en: Today is Monday, and tomorrow is Tuesday.

entries.example_en: My mom always wakes me up at six.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ lúc nào cũng gọi mình dậy lúc sáu giờ.
entries.cloze_en: My mom always wakes me up at six, every day of the week.

entries.example_en: We have English on Friday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Sáu tụi mình có tiết tiếng Anh.
entries.cloze_en: Friday comes after Thursday and before Saturday.

entries.example_en: The bus comes in five minutes.
entries.example_vi: Năm phút nữa xe buýt đến.
entries.cloze_en: There are sixty seconds in one minute.

entries.example_en: School starts again on Monday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Hai lại đi học rồi.
entries.cloze_en: Monday is the day after Sunday.

entries.example_en: What time do you go to bed?
entries.example_vi: Bạn đi ngủ lúc mấy giờ?
entries.cloze_en: What time do you go to bed? — At ten o'clock.

entries.definition_en: a word or sign like one, two or 3
entries.example_en: What is your phone number?
entries.example_vi: Số điện thoại của bạn là gì?
entries.cloze_en: My phone number is 0912 345 678. Please call me.

entries.example_en: We visit Grandma every Sunday.
entries.example_vi: Chủ nhật nào nhà mình cũng thăm bà.
entries.cloze_en: Sunday is the day after Saturday.

entries.example_en: There are twenty students in my class.
entries.example_vi: Lớp mình có hai mươi học sinh.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that ten and ten make twenty.

entries.definition_en: the time between the afternoon and the night
entries.example_en: In the evening, we watch TV together.
entries.example_vi: Buổi tối cả nhà mình xem TV cùng nhau.
entries.cloze_en: In the evening, after dinner, we watch TV together.

entries.definition_en: the early part of the day, before twelve o'clock
entries.example_en: I drink milk in the morning.
entries.example_vi: Mình uống sữa vào buổi sáng.
entries.cloze_en: I get up at six in the morning and eat breakfast.

entries.definition_en: used after a number to say the exact hour
entries.example_en: The movie starts at eight o'clock.
entries.example_vi: Phim bắt đầu lúc tám giờ đúng.
entries.cloze_en: The movie starts at eight o'clock, so we leave home at seven.

entries.example_en: I have a piano lesson on Tuesday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Ba mình có buổi học đàn piano.
entries.cloze_en: Tuesday is the day that comes after Monday.

entries.definition_en: in the way that happens most times
entries.example_en: I usually walk to school with Lan.
entries.example_vi: Mình thường đi bộ đến trường với Lan.
entries.cloze_en: I usually walk to school, but today I take the bus.

entries.example_en: What do you do on the weekend?
entries.example_vi: Cuối tuần bạn làm gì?
entries.cloze_en: Saturday and Sunday are the weekend, so there is no school.

entries.example_en: On Saturday, we clean the house.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Bảy nhà mình dọn dẹp nhà cửa.
entries.cloze_en: Saturday is the day before Sunday.

entries.definition_en: to lie down in your bed to sleep
entries.example_en: I go to bed at ten every night.
entries.example_vi: Tối nào mình cũng đi ngủ lúc mười giờ.
entries.cloze_en: I am very tired, so I go to bed at nine tonight.

entries.example_en: Our class has art on Thursday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Năm lớp mình có tiết mỹ thuật.
entries.cloze_en: Thursday comes after Wednesday and before Friday.

entries.example_en: See you at school tomorrow!
entries.example_vi: Mai gặp nhau ở trường nhé!
entries.cloze_en: Today is Monday, so tomorrow is Tuesday.

entries.definition_en: the time between twelve o'clock and the evening
entries.example_en: I play badminton in the afternoon.
entries.example_vi: Mình chơi cầu lông vào buổi chiều.
entries.cloze_en: School ends at three in the afternoon, and then I go home.

entries.example_en: The market is busy on Wednesday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Tư chợ đông người.
entries.cloze_en: Wednesday is the day that comes after Tuesday.

entries.example_en: I was sick yesterday, but I am fine now.
entries.example_vi: Hôm qua mình bị ốm nhưng giờ khỏe rồi.
entries.cloze_en: I was sick yesterday, but I am fine now.

entries.example_en: We moved to this house two years ago.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình chuyển đến đây cách đây hai năm.
entries.cloze_en: We moved to this house two years ago.

entries.definition_en: used after a time to mean in the morning
entries.example_en: The train leaves at 7 a.m.
entries.example_vi: Tàu chạy lúc bảy giờ sáng.
entries.cloze_en: I get up at 6 a.m. when the sun comes up.

entries.definition_en: the day, month or year when something happens
entries.example_en: What is the date today?
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay là ngày bao nhiêu?
entries.cloze_en: What is the date today? — It is May 5.

entries.example_en: Can I have half of your cake?
entries.example_vi: Cho mình một nửa cái bánh của bạn nhé?
entries.cloze_en: Cut the cake into two parts: one half is for you, and one is for me.

entries.definition_en: the seventh month of the year
entries.example_en: Summer vacation starts in July.
entries.example_vi: Kỳ nghỉ hè bắt đầu vào tháng Bảy.
entries.cloze_en: July comes after June and before August.

entries.example_en: Lunch is at half past eleven.
entries.example_vi: Bữa trưa lúc mười một giờ rưỡi.
entries.cloze_en: Lunch is at half past twelve, so we eat at 12:30.

entries.definition_en: the sixth month of the year
entries.example_en: The school year ends in June.
entries.example_vi: Năm học kết thúc vào tháng Sáu.
entries.cloze_en: June is the month that comes after May.

entries.definition_en: coming after the usual or right time
entries.example_en: Sorry, the bus is late today.
entries.example_vi: Xin lỗi, hôm nay xe buýt đến trễ.
entries.cloze_en: Sorry, I am late. The bus didn't come on time.

entries.definition_en: after the usual or right time
entries.example_en: My dad works late on Friday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Sáu bố mình làm việc đến muộn.
entries.cloze_en: My dad works late on Friday, so he comes home at ten p.m.

entries.definition_en: used after a time to mean after twelve o'clock in the day
entries.example_en: The shop closes at 9 p.m.
entries.example_vi: Cửa hàng đóng cửa lúc chín giờ tối.
entries.cloze_en: The shop closes at 9 p.m., when it is dark outside.

entries.definition_en: in a short time from now
entries.example_en: Hurry up! The bus is coming soon.
entries.example_vi: Nhanh lên! Xe buýt sắp đến rồi.
entries.cloze_en: Hurry up! The bus is coming soon.

entries.example_en: I do my homework, then I watch TV.
entries.example_vi: Mình làm bài tập xong rồi xem TV.
entries.cloze_en: First I do my homework, and then I watch TV.

entries.example_en: Let's play that game again!
entries.example_vi: Mình chơi lại trò đó đi!
entries.cloze_en: I don't understand. Can you say it again, please?

entries.definition_en: the fourth month of the year
entries.example_en: It is very hot in April.
entries.example_vi: Tháng Tư trời rất nóng.
entries.cloze_en: April comes after March and before May.

entries.definition_en: a thing on a wall or table that shows the time
entries.example_en: The clock in our kitchen is slow.
entries.example_vi: Đồng hồ trong bếp nhà mình chạy chậm.
entries.cloze_en: The clock on the kitchen wall says it is seven o'clock.

entries.example_en: We had a test last week.
entries.example_vi: Tuần trước tụi mình có bài kiểm tra.
entries.cloze_en: We had a test last week, so there is no test this week.

entries.definition_en: before the usual or planned time
entries.example_en: I get to school early to play with friends.
entries.example_vi: Mình đến trường sớm để chơi với bạn.
entries.cloze_en: I get to school early, at six thirty, before my friends come.

entries.example_en: My grandma is fifty years old.
entries.example_vi: Bà mình năm mươi tuổi.
entries.cloze_en: Twenty and thirty make fifty in our math lesson.

entries.example_en: Our lesson is forty minutes long.
entries.example_vi: Tiết học của tụi mình dài bốn mươi phút.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that twenty and twenty make forty.

entries.example_en: I am busy now. Call me later.
entries.example_vi: Giờ mình đang bận. Lát nữa gọi lại nhé.
entries.cloze_en: I am busy now, so please call me later, after dinner.

entries.definition_en: the third month of the year
entries.example_en: Women's Day in Vietnam is in March.
entries.example_vi: Ngày Quốc tế Phụ nữ ở Việt Nam là vào tháng Ba.
entries.cloze_en: March is the month that comes after February.

entries.example_en: There are sixty minutes in an hour.
entries.example_vi: Một giờ có sáu mươi phút.
entries.cloze_en: There are sixty minutes in one hour.

entries.example_en: Let's start the game now.
entries.example_vi: Mình bắt đầu trò chơi thôi.
entries.cloze_en: Let's start the game now. Everyone is ready.

entries.example_en: Today is my brother's birthday.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay là sinh nhật anh mình.
entries.cloze_en: Today is my brother's birthday, so we have a party tonight.

entries.definition_en: a small clock you wear on your arm
entries.example_en: My dad gives me a new watch.
entries.example_vi: Bố tặng mình một chiếc đồng hồ đeo tay mới.
entries.cloze_en: I wear a watch on my arm to know the time.

entries.definition_en: the eighth month of the year
entries.example_en: We go to the beach in August.
entries.example_vi: Tháng Tám nhà mình đi biển.
entries.cloze_en: August is the month that comes after July.

entries.example_en: The old man next door is eighty years old.
entries.example_vi: Ông cụ nhà bên đã tám mươi tuổi.
entries.cloze_en: Forty and forty make eighty in our math lesson.

entries.example_en: I will be ten next year.
entries.example_vi: Năm sau mình sẽ lên mười tuổi.
entries.cloze_en: I am nine now, so I will be ten next year.

entries.example_en: There are eleven players on a soccer team.
entries.example_vi: Một đội bóng đá có mười một cầu thủ.
entries.cloze_en: Ten and one make eleven in our math lesson.

entries.definition_en: to come to the end of doing something
entries.example_en: I finish my homework before dinner.
entries.example_vi: Mình làm xong bài tập trước bữa tối.
entries.cloze_en: I finish my homework before dinner, and then I watch TV.

entries.example_en: The movie is ninety minutes long.
entries.example_vi: Bộ phim dài chín mươi phút.
entries.cloze_en: Fifty and forty make ninety in our math lesson.

entries.example_en: My classroom is on the second floor.
entries.example_vi: Lớp học của mình ở tầng hai.
entries.cloze_en: February is the second month of the year.

entries.example_en: April and June have thirty days.
entries.example_vi: Tháng Tư và tháng Sáu có ba mươi ngày.
entries.cloze_en: Twenty and ten make thirty in our math lesson.

entries.example_en: A year has twelve months.
entries.example_vi: Một năm có mười hai tháng.
entries.cloze_en: A year has twelve months, from January to December.

entries.example_en: The break is fifteen minutes long.
entries.example_vi: Giờ ra chơi dài mười lăm phút.
entries.cloze_en: Ten and five make fifteen in our math lesson.

entries.definition_en: the first month of the year
entries.example_en: It is cold in Hanoi in January.
entries.example_vi: Tháng Một ở Hà Nội trời lạnh.
entries.cloze_en: January is the first month of the year.

entries.definition_en: the tenth month of the year
entries.example_en: My sister's birthday is in October.
entries.example_vi: Sinh nhật chị mình vào tháng Mười.
entries.cloze_en: October is the month that comes after September.

entries.example_en: My grandpa is seventy, but he still runs every day.
entries.example_vi: Ông mình bảy mươi tuổi nhưng ngày nào cũng chạy bộ.
entries.cloze_en: Forty and thirty make seventy in our math lesson.

entries.definition_en: at the right time, not late
entries.example_en: Please come to class on time.
entries.example_vi: Các em hãy đến lớp đúng giờ nhé.
entries.cloze_en: The class starts at eight, and I arrive at eight, so I am on time.

entries.example_en: My cousin is sixteen years old.
entries.example_vi: Anh họ mình mười sáu tuổi.
entries.cloze_en: Ten and six make sixteen in our math lesson.

entries.example_en: What do you want to eat tonight?
entries.example_vi: Tối nay bạn muốn ăn gì?
entries.cloze_en: It is morning now, but tonight we watch a movie after dinner.

entries.definition_en: the eleventh month of the year
entries.example_en: Teachers' Day in Vietnam is in November.
entries.example_vi: Ngày Nhà giáo Việt Nam là vào tháng Mười Một.
entries.cloze_en: November is the month that comes after October.

entries.example_en: There are thirteen girls in our class.
entries.example_vi: Lớp tụi mình có mười ba bạn nữ.
entries.cloze_en: Ten and three make thirteen in our math lesson.

entries.example_en: Tomorrow is Saturday. We have no school.
entries.example_vi: Ngày mai là thứ Bảy, tụi mình được nghỉ học.
entries.cloze_en: It is Friday, so tomorrow is Saturday and we have no school.
